words.gloss: both kinds of deeds (good and bad)

literal: Darkness-associated both-deeds will-not-cling, the Lord's truth-associated praise those-who-cherished with.
translation: The two-fold deeds born of dark ignorance will never cling to those who sincerely cherish the true praise of the Lord.
modern: இறைவனுடைய மெய்யான புகழை விரும்பிப் போற்றுபவர்களிடம், அறியாமை என்னும் இருளினால் உண்டாகும் நல்வினை தீவினை ஆகிய இருவினைகளும் சேரமாட்டா.
explanation: This couplet explains how devotion frees a person from the cycle of action and consequence. The word 'இருள்' (darkness) represents spiritual ignorance, which is the root cause of all human actions. The 'இருவினை' (two-fold deeds) refer to both good and bad deeds, both of which bind the soul to worldly existence. By focusing on the 'பொருள்சேர் புகழ்' (true praise) of the supreme being, a person overcomes this ignorance. Consequently, they are freed from the binding nature of karma, as actions no longer cling to them.
